statement: The system shall allow customers to apply for a personal loan online without visiting a branch.
quote: Customers must be able to apply for a personal loan online, end to end, without visiting a branch.

statement: The system shall support a decision within two working days for a complete application.
quote: A customer with a complete application should get a decision within two working days.

statement: The system shall allow the applicant to accept a loan offer electronically.
quote: the applicant should be able to accept the offer electronically, with no wet signature.

statement: The system shall show applicants which required documents are still missing.
quote: Applicants never know which documents are still missing, so they phone us

statement: The system shall allow applicants to upload payslips, bank statements and proof of address into the application.
quote: Applicants need to be able to upload payslips, bank statements and proof of address straight into the application.

statement: The system shall accept uploaded files only in PDF, JPEG or PNG format and reject other formats with a clear message.
quote: For uploads we will accept PDF, JPEG and PNG files. Anything else should be rejected with a clear message.

statement: The system shall limit the size of each uploaded file.
quote: There also needs to be a size limit on each uploaded file, but we have not agreed the number yet.

statement: The system shall allow applicants to save a partially completed application and resume it later.
quote: They should be able to save a half-finished application and come back to it later without losing anything.

statement: The system shall show applicants the current status of their application.
quote: Applicants must be able to see the current status of their application in the portal.

statement: The system shall email the applicant whenever the status of their application changes.
quote: Whenever the status changes, the applicant should get an email telling them.

statement: The system shall send applicants an SMS when the status of their application changes.
quote: status changes should also be sent to them by SMS.

statement: The system shall pre-fill the application with an existing customer's details when they log in.
quote: When an existing customer logs in, their details should already be filled in.

statement: The system shall check that every mandatory field is completed before an application is submitted.
quote: Before anything is submitted, the portal must check that every mandatory field is completed.

statement: The system shall automatically place every new application in a loan officer's work queue.
quote: Every new application should land automatically in a loan officer's work queue.

statement: The system shall allow loan officers to request additional documents from the applicant through the portal.
quote: Loan officers must be able to request extra documents from the applicant through the portal instead of by email.

statement: The system shall flag to the team lead any application with no activity for five working days.
quote: If nothing has happened on an application for five working days, the system should flag it to the team lead.

statement: The system shall leave the final credit decision to a human underwriter and shall not approve or decline applications automatically.
quote: the final credit decision must always be made by a human underwriter. No automated approvals or declines.

statement: The system shall record the underwriter's decision together with the reason for it.
quote: The underwriter's decision has to be recorded together with the reason for it.

statement: The system shall retrieve credit reports from the credit bureau through its API.
quote: credit reports must be pulled from the credit bureau through their API rather than downloaded by hand.

statement: The system shall hand approved and accepted loans over to the core banking system so the loan account can be opened.
quote: the portal needs to hand it over to the core banking system so the loan account can be opened.

statement: The system shall let applicants submit while the credit bureau is unavailable and run the queued credit check when it is back.
quote: applicants should still be able to submit, and the credit check can wait in a queue and run once the service is back.

statement: The system shall let staff sign in with the bank's existing single sign-on.
quote: Staff should sign in with the bank's existing single sign-on, not with yet another password.

statement: The system shall load each page of the application within two seconds.
quote: Each page of the application should load within two seconds.

statement: The system shall support 500 concurrent applicants.
quote: supporting 500 applicants at the same time is plenty for us.

statement: The system shall support up to 2,000 concurrent applicants at month end.
quote: marketing expects up to 2,000 people applying at the same time, and the portal has to cope with that.

statement: The system shall display the loan officers' dashboard quickly.
quote: And the loan officers' dashboard needs to be fast.

statement: The system shall be available 99.9 percent of the time during business hours.
quote: We would sign up to 99.9 percent availability during business hours.

statement: The system shall be available to customers 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
quote: the portal has to be available 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

statement: The system shall allow a planned maintenance window on Sunday nights between midnight and 4 a.m.
quote: The platform team patches on Sunday nights between midnight and 4 a.m., and the portal will be offline then.

statement: The system shall be running again from the secondary site within four hours of losing the primary data centre.
quote: the portal must be running again from the secondary site within four hours

statement: The system shall lose no more than 15 minutes of applications after a data-centre failure.
quote: we cannot lose more than 15 minutes of applications.

statement: The system shall require multi-factor authentication for all staff users.
quote: All staff users must use multi-factor authentication.

statement: The system shall require applicants to confirm their identity with a one-time passcode before they can see an application.
quote: Applicants should confirm their identity with a one-time passcode sent to their phone before they can see an application.

statement: The system shall lock an account after five failed login attempts.
quote: After five failed login attempts the account should be locked.

statement: The system shall encrypt customer data at rest and in transit.
quote: All customer data has to be encrypted, both when it is stored and when it travels between systems.

statement: The system shall scan uploaded documents for malware before staff can open them.
quote: Uploaded documents must be scanned for malware before anyone on staff opens them.

statement: The system shall give every member of staff an individual login.
quote: With the new portal every member of staff gets their own login

statement: The system shall keep applicant data inside the portal rather than in emailed spreadsheets.
quote: and applicant data stays inside the portal.

statement: The system shall end staff sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.
quote: Staff sessions should time out after 15 minutes of inactivity.

statement: The system shall keep loan officers' sessions open for at least an hour.
quote: Loan officers need their sessions to stay open for at least an hour.

statement: The system shall show loan officers only the applications assigned to their own team.
quote: a loan officer should only see the applications assigned to their own team, not every application in the bank.

statement: The system shall collect only the personal data needed to assess the loan.
quote: we should only collect the personal data we actually need to assess the loan.

statement: The system shall capture and store the applicant's consent to a credit check before contacting the credit bureau.
quote: The applicant's consent to a credit check has to be captured and stored before the bureau is contacted.

statement: The system shall mask national ID numbers on staff screens, showing only the last four digits.
quote: National ID numbers should be masked on staff screens, showing only the last four digits.

statement: The system shall let applicants request a copy of the personal data held about them.
quote: applicants can ask for a copy of the personal data we hold about them, and the portal should let them make that request.

statement: The system shall delete documents from declined applications after a retention period.
quote: Documents from declined applications should be deleted after a while.

statement: The system shall show the applicant the annual percentage rate and the total cost of credit before they accept an offer.
quote: the applicant sees the annual percentage rate and the total cost of the credit before they accept an offer.

statement: The system shall complete identity verification (KYC) checks before an application goes to an underwriter.
quote: Identity verification, our KYC checks, must be completed before an application goes to an underwriter.

statement: The system shall screen every applicant against the sanctions lists.
quote: Every applicant also has to be screened against the sanctions lists.

statement: The system shall keep records of approved loans for as long as the regulations require.
quote: Records of approved loans must be kept for as long as the regulations require.

statement: The system shall tell the applicant the main reasons when an application is declined.
quote: When an application is declined, the applicant must be told the main reasons for the decision.

statement: The system shall record every change to an application with who made it and when.
quote: Every change to an application must be recorded with who made it and when.

statement: The system shall prevent anyone, including administrators, from editing or deleting audit records.
quote: Those audit records must not be editable or deletable by anyone, including administrators.

statement: The system shall give internal auditors read-only access to the full history of any application.
quote: My team needs read-only access to the full history of any application.

statement: The system shall log every access to a customer's credit report.
quote: Every time someone opens a customer's credit report, that access should be logged as well.

statement: The system shall produce a monthly report of how many applications were received, approved and declined.
quote: I need a monthly report showing how many applications we received, approved and declined.

statement: The system shall let business administrators change the list of required documents without a software release.
quote: business administrators should be able to change the list of required documents without waiting for a software release.

statement: The system shall automatically alert the support team when an integration with the credit bureau or the core banking system fails.
quote: If an integration with the bureau or the core banking system fails, the support team must be alerted automatically.

statement: The system shall work well on mobile phones.
quote: the portal has to work well on mobile.

statement: The system shall show the credit bureau report to the underwriter inside the application screen.
quote: The credit bureau report should be shown to the underwriter inside the application screen, so they do not have to open another system.
